port: Pin of this circuit when it is placed as a block (Place > Block); side: where the pin goes
decoder_4511: CMOS BCD to 7-segment decoder (CD4511) for common cathode; tie LT and BI high, LE low
decoder_7447: TTL BCD to 7-segment decoder (7447) for common anode; open-collector outputs
decoder_hex_ca: 4-bit decoder showing 0-9 and A-F on a common-anode display
decoder_hex_cc: 4-bit decoder showing 0-9 and A-F on a common-cathode display
seven_segment_ca: 7-segment LED display, common anode, real pinout; one resistor per segment
seven_segment_cc: 7-segment LED display, common cathode, real pinout; one resistor per segment
dcmotor: Small permanent-magnet DC motor without load; shows its speed
relay: Relay with a coil and a changeover contact; add a flyback diode across the coil
opamp: Operational amplifier (behavioral or a vendor model), powered by V+ and V-
and_gate: Two-input AND gate (74HC-like, hidden supply VDD)
nand_gate: Two-input NAND gate (74HC-like, hidden supply VDD)
nor_gate: Two-input NOR gate (74HC-like, hidden supply VDD)
or_gate: Two-input OR gate (74HC-like, hidden supply VDD)
xor_gate: Two-input XOR gate (74HC-like, hidden supply VDD)
bluepill: STM32F103C8 board running your firmware (ELF) in the SimNodus emulator
transformer: Two windings on one core: primary P1-P2, secondary S1-S2
lm317: Adjustable positive regulator (LM317): OUT stays 1.25 V above ADJ
regulator_78xx: Fixed positive regulator (7805, 7812...): set the output voltage
tl431: Adjustable shunt reference (TL431): 2.495 V between REF and A
ideal_diode: Teaching model: conducts above a fixed forward voltage Vf
simple_npn: Teaching model: fixed Vbe, collector current = beta x base current
simple_pnp: Teaching model: fixed Vbe, collector current = beta x base current
counter10: Decade counter 0-9 (74HC160-like) at rising edges of CLK; CLR resets
counter4: 4-bit binary counter 0-15 (74HC161-like) at rising edges of CLK; CLR resets
d_flipflop: D flip-flop: Q takes D at each rising edge of CLK
d_latch: D latch: Q follows D while EN is high, holds while EN is low
jk_flipflop: JK flip-flop at rising edges of CLK: set, reset, toggle or hold
shift4: 4-bit shift register, serial in, parallel out (74HC164-like); CLR resets
sr_latch: SR latch: S sets Q, R resets it (R wins); holds while both are low
t_flipflop: T flip-flop: Q toggles at each rising edge of CLK while T is high
